+title: 'T1 follow-up b1: compaction suites close each session, also when the body throws'
+---
+Source: task ^dbr1dqy (T1 audit, done). The audit left "tests that never close their session or router at all (about 60 suites)" out of scope. A new check on 2026-10-17 found 107 suites with tests that make a RoutedSession and never close it. `Router` has no `close()`; only `RoutedSession` does, so this group is about sessions only. This card has the compaction suites.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (run settle, session close, stream end), or the test must fail before it waits. A fixture closes also when the test body throws.
+Exception rule: first use an event that already exists (the session closes, the run settles, the feed ends). A hook only in test helpers is permitted. Do not change production code only for a test hook. When a case needs such a change, bring it to the coordinating session (swissarmyhammer-96) before you change it. Do not use `.timeLimit`, sleep, poll or retry. Run the full suite one time.
+Work rules: do the work in one agent. Do not run parallel agents on the tree. Edit files only with the edit tool. Do not run swift format.
+
+How to close (use the forms that T1 added):
+- Put `defer { await <session>.close() }` right after the session is made, for each session the test makes (root, fork, restored session). With gates, use `SessionFixtureLifecycle.close(_:opening:)` (Helpers/SessionFixtureLifecycle.swift:83). `close()` is idempotent.
+- When a helper makes the session and returns only events or text (for example a local `runAnswer`, `collect`), close the session inside the helper, with a `defer` or `RouterTestFixtures.removingDirectoryOnThrow(_:alsoOnThrow:_:)` (Helpers/RouterTestFixtures.swift:156) for the throw path and a close on the success path.
+- Helpers that close only on a throw (`removingDirectoryOnThrow(alsoOnThrow:)`, `AutoCompactionFixtures.makeTriggeredSession`, `Fixtures.makeCompactionTriggeredSession`) do not close on success. The test must still close.
+- A test that closes before it reads the journal keeps that close; the `defer` then finds it done.
+- After a close, a test that waits on a feed now ends on the feed end. Check that no test now passes only because a wait ends early.
+
+Suites (file under Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/; the tests that never close):
+- [ ] AnswerCancellationTests extension, AnswerCancellationCompactionTests.swift: 8 of 15 (aStopDuringAProactiveCompactionLetsItEndThenCancelsTheAnswer, summarizerCancellationErrorWithNoStopOutstandingStillDegrades, aSummarizerFaultWhileAStopIsOutstandingStillDegrades, aRequestedCompactionRunsBesideAnAnswerAndAppliesAfterItsSubmission, anAnswerStoppedDuringItsProactiveCompactionLosesNoRunMail, aStopDuringTheReactiveCompactionLetsItEndAndSkipsTheRetry, failedAutomaticCompactionReportsItsFailure, compactionWithNoStopOutstandingIsUnaffected).
+- [ ] AutoCompactionTests, AutoCompactionTests.swift: 17 of 20 (all session tests except the one that closes).
+- [ ] CeilingStopCompactionTests, CeilingStopCompactionTests.swift: all 3 (local makeAnswerEvents).
+- [ ] CompactionRenderCounterTests, CompactionRenderCounterTests.swift: all 6 (makeProbe / RenderProbeSessionFixture.make, MeteredToolLoopSessionFixture.make).
+- [ ] CompactionSegmentTests, CompactionSegmentTests.swift: 2 of 11 (compactionSegmentRoundTripsThroughRecordingMirror, restoreSessionTreeRestoresCompactionSegment).
+- [ ] CompactionSpikeTests, CompactionSpikeTests.swift: 1 of 3 (synthesizedTranscriptRoundTripsThroughFullRecordingMirror).
+- [ ] ForkAfterCompactionRestorationTests, ForkAfterCompactionRestorationTests.swift: all 3.
+- [ ] RoutedSessionCompactTests, RoutedSessionCompactTests.swift: all 14.
+- [ ] ToolResultCompactionTests, ToolResultCompactionTests.swift: all 7 (local makeFixture; InFlightTranscriptTests in the same file is value-only).
+- [ ] SummarizerPromptCacheTests, SummarizerPromptCacheTests.swift: all 2 (local makeFixture).
+- [ ] SummarizerSubmissionTests, SummarizerSubmissionTests.swift: 1 of 2 (aFlashSummarizerCallAndAFlashSubmissionNeverOverlap; close the standard and the flash session).
+- [ ] Run the full suite one time (`swift test`). Record the counts in a comment. #t1-followup
\ No newline at end of file
